title: Mecanum Drive

tests.name: Front left motor power is 0.5 (forward only)
Back left motor power is 0.5 (forward only)
Front right motor power is 0.5 (forward only)
Back right motor power is 0.5 (forward only)

hints.title: Getting four motors
hints.content: Get each motor the same way: `DcMotor frontLeft = hardwareMap.get(DcMotor.class, "frontLeft");` Repeat for `backLeft`, `frontRight`, and `backRight`.

hints.title: Calculating the movement components
hints.content: Remember to negate left_stick_y: `double y = -gamepad1.left_stick_y;` The strafe gets a correction: `double x = gamepad1.left_stick_x * 1.1;` Rotation is direct: `double rx = gamepad1.right_stick_x;`

hints.title: What should the denominator be?
hints.content: With y=0.5, x=0.0, rx=0.0: `Math.abs(0.5) + Math.abs(0.0) + Math.abs(0.0) = 0.5`. Since 0.5 < 1, `Math.max(0.5, 1) = 1`. So the denominator is 1 and all powers are simply 0.5.

hints.title: The mecanum formula
hints.content: frontLeft = (y + x + rx) / denom, backLeft = (y - x + rx) / denom, frontRight = (y - x - rx) / denom, backRight = (y + x - rx) / denom. With y=0.5 and x=rx=0, all equal 0.5/1 = 0.5.
